title: Horrent
summary: HOR'RENT, adjective [Latin horrens. See Horror.] Bristled; standing erect as bristles; pointing outward. With bright emblazonry and horrent arms.

inlines.v: HOR'RENT, adjective [Latin horrens. See Horror.] Bristled; standing erect as bristles; pointing outward. With bright emblazonry and horrent arms.
